images.author: Luis Salazar Vargas
images.why: Source explicitly identifies Pili/Acamarachi viewed from Salar de Pujsa; useful whole-volcano landscape candidate. Native dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability remain unverified.

images.author: Luis Salazar V
images.why: Alternative photograph explicitly captioned Pili from Salar de Pujsa. Correct volcano confirmed by the mountaineering source; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Oscar González-Ferrán
images.why: Authoritatively identified steep cone above Laguna Aguas Calientes, with snow streaks and an unobstructed silhouette. Archival fallback; 2000-pixel availability unverified.

images.author: felipe prado
images.why: Photograph specifically identified as Sairecabur in its dedicated mountaineering gallery, avoiding Licancabur substitutions. Native dimensions and final crop suitability unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Explicitly captioned Sairecabur at sunset; promising warm-light alternative for the volcanic massif. Resolution unverified.

images.author: Valérie Le Bouteiller
images.why: Dramatic ash column and volcanic slopes photographed from Hualca Hualca; the photographer explicitly identifies the erupting volcano as Sabancaya. Strong vertical plume for a near-square crop.

images.author: OVI INGEMMET
images.why: Documented Sabancaya explosion on 16 November 2016, with a towering plume against blue sky. Image-specific licence and native dimensions are not stated.

images.author: Frans Ruiter
images.why: Explicitly identified classic Licancabur cone above the desert near San Pedro de Atacama, photographed from Chile with clear sky.

images.author: alisha jean
images.why: Clearly named Licancabur under clear skies in Chile, with arid Andean terrain. Original download URL provides flexibility for the poster crop.

images.author: Florian Delée
images.why: Photographer identifies Licancabur and locates the view at San Pedro de Atacama; blue sky and open desert provide a landscape alternative.

images.author: Nick Cruz
images.why: Classic snowy Cotopaxi above dry páramo grass, with blue sky and a prominent cone; a strong starting point for the 9:10 card.

images.author: ryan doyle
images.why: Explicitly captioned Cotopaxi from the national park; open grassland and blue tones provide the requested classic landscape setting.

images.author: Mauricio Muñoz
images.why: Snow-covered Cotopaxi photographed with a Nikon D7000; blue sky and a distinct summit offer another recognisable landscape composition.

images.author: César Viteri
images.why: Photographer-confirmed Cotopaxi at dawn above Quito's lights; atmospheric alternative with a snowy summit and illuminated foreground.

images.author: Andres Medina
images.why: Cotopaxi with green vegetation and wildflowers, photographed with a Sony A7 III; a colourful foreground alternative to the dry-páramo views.
